plans.note: Separate caps for each side (9.1 IBM, 9.2 Customer) — compare cap amounts for mutuality/meaningfulness and check carve-outs (IP indemnity, confidentiality, death/bodily injury, willful misconduct). Sec 5.4 may hold additional consequential-damages disclaimers.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity (test IP + misconduct scope); 8.2 is our indemnity (test breadth); sec-1 appears to be the indemnification procedure conditions. Check interaction with the 9.1 liability cap for an indemnity carve-out.
No non-compete heading; 14.16 'Freedom of Action' typically preserves IBM's freedom rather than restricting us. Confirm 14.11 No Resale and the AUP do not operate as a restraint on our business.
Likely no exclusivity obligation on us; verify 14.16 and any sole-source or capacity commitments in 11.5/4.1 before concluding absent.
No pricing MFN heading; scan charges provisions for any obligation on us to extend best terms to IBM. MFN in our favour would be fine if present.
14.8 'Personnel' is the likely home for any hiring/solicitation restriction; check whether it binds us, its duration, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.
3.4 is the core clause: check notice period, whether it is mutual (IBM should not walk mid-term), and any termination charges/unamortized-cost penalties cross-referenced in 3.5 or 4.1.
3.2 Renewal — check auto-renew length, non-renewal notice window, and whether renewal pricing/uplift is predictable; 3.1 sets the initial term baseline.
14.3 Choice of Law is dispositive (NY/DE/CA/E&W acceptable; note if venue is silent). 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 limitations period are related but noted, not double-flagged.
14.10 — confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, and that IBM cannot terminate on our change of control.
Check that our Content/Customer Data ownership is preserved (11.6, 14.18) and that 12.1/14.17 grant only a limited licence to IBM rather than assigning our IP; 14.6 covers trademark use.
12.1 is the grant: test scope for affiliates/contractors, revocability at will, and territorial limits in 14.19; 14.17 and 14.11 impose limitations to review.
No audit heading; 11.3 Suspected Violations may include inspection/investigation rights against us — check notice, frequency, on-site access and cost allocation before treating as absent.
Look for late-payment interest, early-termination charges or stipulated damages payable by us in 4.2/3.5; service credits in our favour are welcome and not flagged.

5.1 is IBM's warranty; assess duration and remedy, then weigh the 5.2 exclusivity-of-warranties and 5.4 disclaimers. 11.1/12.2 (support and maintenance) supply the practical remedy; 11.2 is our warranty.
No insurance heading in the outline; 5.3 Security and 14.12 Risk of Loss are the nearest neighbours. Likely a 'missing' finding given IBM hosts our data.
Check 4.1 Charges and 11.5 Capacity Planning for committed volumes, minimum monthly fees or take-or-pay language tied to the term in 3.1.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the likely home; confirm it provides data return/export in a usable format and transition assistance, not merely cessation of access and payment of accrued fees. 14.2 controls survival.
